name.mr: इतर मागास वर्ग विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी मॅट्रिकोत्तर शिष्यवृत्ती
name.hi: अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग विद्यार्थियों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति

department: VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department, Maharashtra

summary.en: Tuition fees, exam fees and a maintenance allowance for OBC students after 10th, with parents' income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

text.en: Belongs to the OBC category

source.quote: Applicant should be belongs to OBC category.

text.en: Parents' annual income ≤ ₹2,50,000

source.quote: The parents/Guardians annual Income should be less than or equal to Rs.2.50 Lac.

text.en: Resident of Maharashtra

source.quote: Applicants must be residents of Maharashtra.

text.en: Studying a government-approved course after 10th

source.quote: Applicants must be pursuing the education course approved by the government from class Post-Matric.

text.en: 75% attendance in the current year

source.quote: 75 % attendance is mandatory for current year.

text.en: Not taking another scholarship or stipend

source.quote: No scholarship will be paid to the Applicants under this scheme from the date he /she accepts another Scholarship / stipend.

text.en: Is your course a professional course (as the scheme defines it)?
text.mr: तुमचा अभ्यासक्रम (योजनेनुसार) व्यावसायिक अभ्यासक्रम आहे का?
text.hi: क्या आपका कोर्स (योजना के अनुसार) व्यावसायिक कोर्स है?

source.quote: Caste Validity Certificate – (Mandatory for Professional Degree courses, Professional Post Graduate.

text.en: Did you have a gap (a year without study) in your education?
text.mr: तुमच्या शिक्षणात खंड (शिक्षण न घेतलेले वर्ष) पडला होता का?
text.hi: क्या आपकी पढ़ाई में कोई अंतराल (बिना पढ़ाई का साल) रहा है?

source.quote: Gap certificate - Not mandatory but in case of gap it is mandatory.

text.en: Has your father (or guardian) passed away? Answer only if you are comfortable; it decides one document.
text.mr: तुमचे वडील (किंवा पालक) हयात नाहीत का? सांगणे ऐच्छिक आहे; त्यावर एक कागदपत्र ठरते.
text.hi: क्या आपके पिता (या अभिभावक) का निधन हो चुका है? बताना आपकी इच्छा है; इससे एक दस्तावेज़ तय होता है।

source.quote: If applicable father/Guardians death certificate.

text.en: Is your course approved by the government?
text.hi: क्या आपका कोर्स सरकार से मान्यता प्राप्त है?

source.quote: Applicants must be pursuing the education course approved by the government from class Post-Matric.

text.en: Are you getting any other scholarship, stipend, fee waiver or reimbursement this year?
text.mr: तुम्हाला या वर्षी दुसरी शिष्यवृत्ती, विद्यावेतन, शुल्कमाफी किंवा शुल्क परतावा मिळतो का?
text.hi: क्या आपको इस साल कोई दूसरी छात्रवृत्ति, वजीफ़ा, फ़ीस माफ़ी या फ़ीस प्रतिपूर्ति मिलती है?

source.quote: No scholarship will be paid to the Applicants under this scheme from the date he /she accepts another Scholarship / stipend.

text.en: Caste certificate (issued by Govt. of Maharashtra)

source.quote: Caste certificate - should be issued by competent authority(Issued by Govt. of Maharashtra)

text.en: Income certificate or income declaration

source.quote: Income certificate / Income Declaration - should be issued by competent authority

text.en: Caste validity certificate (mandatory for professional degree / PG courses)

source.quote: Caste Validity Certificate – (Mandatory for Professional Degree courses, Professional Post Graduate.

text.en: HSC or SSC or last exam marksheet

source.quote: HSC or SSC marksheet or last examination marksheet.

text.en: Gap certificate (if you had a gap)

source.quote: Gap certificate - Not mandatory but in case of gap it is mandatory.

text.en: Father's / guardian's death certificate (if applicable)

source.quote: If applicable father/Guardians death certificate.

text.en: Ration card (to count the children in the family)

source.quote: Ration Card for identify number of children in family.

text.en: Leaving certificate

source.quote: Leaving Certificate

text.en: Parents' declaration about the number of children

source.quote: Declaration certificate of parents/guardians about number of children beneficiaries.

notes: Only two boys of the same parents are eligible; any number of girls (page text).
Professional courses need admission through the CAP round (page text).
VJNT and SBC students have separate MahaDBT schemes; not covered by this pack.
The page states no academic year or deadline.
